Definition: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
BiblicalUsage: 1) sea; 1a) Mediterranean Sea; 1b) Red Sea; 1c) Dead Sea; 1d) Sea of Galilee; 1e) sea (general); 1f) mighty river (Nile); 1g) the sea (the great basin in the temple court); 1h) seaward, west, westward
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
